mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(access_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS pv FROM short_url_access_log WHERE short_code = #{shortCode} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(access_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT IFNULL(referer, '直接访问') AS referer, COUNT(*) AS pv FROM short_url_access_log WHERE short_code = #{shortCode} GROUP BY referer ORDER BY pv DESC
SELECT IFNULL(device, '未知设备') AS device, COUNT(*) AS pv FROM short_url_access_log WHERE short_code = #{shortCode} GROUP BY device ORDER BY pv DESC
